title: Invoices: authenticity of origin and integrity of content from issue to the end of storage
summary: What a business records so it can show that an invoice it issued or received has not been altered since the day it was issued, without sending the invoice anywhere. One business control among those the directive leaves to the taxable person.

articles.asks: The authenticity of the origin, the integrity of the content and the legibility of an invoice, on paper or electronic, are ensured from the point in time of issue until the end of the period for storage; each taxable person determines how, for example by business controls that create a reliable audit trail between an invoice and a supply.
Every taxable person ensures that copies of the invoices issued by it, by its customer or by a third party on its behalf, and all the invoices it has received, are stored.

kinds.title: Invoice issued
kinds.when: When the invoice is issued, before it is sent: the file exactly as issued is sealed by its digest.

fields.name: issued_on
fields.description: The date of issue on the invoice.

fields.name: invoice_digest
fields.description: SHA-256 of the invoice file exactly as issued (the XML of an e-invoice, or the PDF).

fields.name: supply_ref
fields.description: Your reference for the supply invoiced (an order or a delivery), the link in the audit trail.

kinds.title: Invoice received
kinds.when: When an invoice is received, before it is processed.

fields.name: invoice_digest
fields.description: SHA-256 of the invoice file exactly as received.

retention: Article 247(1) leaves the storage period to each Member State. This pack does not decide it for you; check the period where the supply takes place.
notes: The invoice never leaves you: only its digest is sealed. A seal shows the invoice has not changed since it was sealed; it does not show the invoice is correct or that VAT is due. Directive (EU) 2025/516 (ViDA) amends the invoicing rules from dates it sets; check the consolidated text.
